flags.why: Lanh describes quickness or sharpness, not a changeable temperament ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/lanh-e5mEifjQqruna.html)).
Cầm đồ chiếc đồng hồ is an unnatural construction for pawning a watch.
flags.fix: Anh ấy phải đem chiếc đồng hồ đi cầm đồ để lấy tiền. = He had to pawn his watch to get money.

flags.why: Sung is the cluster fig, Ficus racemosa, whereas sycamore fig names a different species ([PROSEA](https://prosea.prota4u.org/view.aspx?id=1660)).
The entry omits the common colloquial adjective meaning energetic or enthusiastic.
flags.fix: adj [colloquial] | energetic; enthusiastic — Hôm nay anh ấy hát rất sung. = Today he sang with great energy.

flags.why: The example explains how hội ý works instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Cô giáo yêu cầu chúng tôi tìm ba chữ hội ý. = The teacher asked us to find three compound ideographs.

flags.why: Thân ái belongs chiefly to formal greetings and written expression, so leaving it untagged suggests ordinary conversational usage ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/th%C3%A2n%20%C3%A1i%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
Thú tính denotes animal instinct or bestial urges rather than the adjective bestial ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%C3%BA_t%C3%ADnh)).
